subject: Next steps & stakeholder map — procurement gaps for HealthGrid pilot
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Higgins <laura.higgins@healthgrid.com>, Marcus Torres <m.torres@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & stakeholder map — procurement gaps for HealthGrid pilot

Hi Laura / Marcus,

Great to meet you both on the call earlier — thanks for walking us through the pilot goals and the initial integration architecture. Quick recap and the asks we promised: 

- Objective: 6-week pilot (EHR data anonymization + structured QA prompts) to validate latency and cost at 8K tokens/session.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: data residency, SOC2 + penetration test, and a procurement-friendly DPA.

Can you help with the following so we can finalize a mutual action plan (MAP)?
1) Stakeholder map: who is the economic buyer (name + email), who signs contracts (legal/procurement contact), and who owns security/compliance (infosec lead)? A simple org-chart or list is perfect.
2) Procurement timeline: target date to complete SOW + PO? Any internal procurement windows or fiscal constraints to be aware of?
3) Security evidence: do you need a completed security questionnaire or standard vendor packet? We attached our short questionnaire (redwood_security_questionnaire.xlsx) and a draft SOW stub (HealthGrid_SOW_v0.1.pdf) for your review.

Next steps from our side: Marcus Lin will confirm SOC2 report availability and provide a one-page summary of our data handling posture. Ben will prepare a short TCO slide for the pilot.

If you can share the stakeholder contacts and an estimated procurement cutover date, we’ll draft a MAP with milestones and owners and circulate by Monday.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood_security_questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: HealthGrid_SOW_v0.1.pdf (PDF)
From: Laura Higgins <laura.higgins@healthgrid.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Torres <m.torres@healthgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps & stakeholder map — procurement gaps for HealthGrid pilot

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers and clarifications: 

- Economic buyer: Claire Donovan (VP Product) — claire.donovan@healthgrid.com. She owns budget approvals for pilots.
- Legal/Procurement POC: I looped in procurement earlier but primary contact is Luis Mata (procurement@healthgrid.com). Contracts typically go through our centralized sourcing team.
- Infosec: Marcus Torres (me) is handling security evidence; I’m also bringing in Raj Patel (senior infosec) once we have the vendor packet.

Timeline: We’re aiming to complete vendor selection by 8/18 to start pilots in early September. Procurement windows are tight — sourcing needs SOW + completed questionnaire to move to legal review.

I attached the initial stakeholder list (quick spreadsheet) and some notes on internal gate dates. I’ll review your SOW tonight. Two asks from our side: 1) does Redwood accept our template DPA (I can send), and 2) can you confirm whether SOC2 Type II is available for the past 12 months?

Happy to hop on a short follow-up on Wed if that helps.

Cheers,
Laura
Director, Partnerships — HealthGrid
Attachment: HG-stakeholders-initial.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Higgins <laura.higgins@healthgrid.com>, Marcus Torres <m.torres@healthgrid.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & stakeholder map — procurement gaps for HealthGrid pilot

Thanks Laura — helpful. Quick technical/compliance clarifications from our side: 

- SOC2: yes, we have a SOC2 Type II report in the last 12 months. We can provide a redacted copy under NDA; alternatively we can provide the high-level control summary and attestations.
- Pen test: we completed a third-party pentest within the last 9 months; summary findings are available.
- Data residency: for the pilot we can provision instances in us-west-2 and encrypt at rest with customer-managed keys (KMS).

On contracting: we typically accept partner DPAs but need to review for any vendor liability caps and data-use clauses. If you send your template DPA we’ll loop in legal and come back with comments. For procurement routing — who at HealthGrid physically signs the SOW/PO? Laura noted Claire as the economic buyer; we need the legal signatory name or procurement signatory.

Action items we’ll take now:
- I’ll upload a redacted SOC2 + pentest summary to the Drive link Kimberly shared.
- Ben will tailor the MAP with milestones: SOW review (7/24), questionnaire complete (7/26), legal review week of 7/29, anticipated selection 8/18.

If the timeline above looks off, tell us and we’ll adjust. Also, would Wed 7/25 10:00am PT work for a 30-minute checkpoint with Claire + Raj?

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOC2_redacted_summary.pdf (PDF placeholder)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Higgins <laura.higgins@healthgrid.com>, Marcus Torres <m.torres@healthgrid.com>, Claire Donovan <claire.donovan@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Luis Mata <procurement@healthgrid.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & stakeholder map — procurement gaps for HealthGrid pilot

Laura / Claire / Marcus — thanks for the quick replies and for sharing the stakeholder list. Confirming the MAP and next steps below (we’ll update the shared Drive folder as items complete):

- 7/24: Redwood to submit updated SOW (HealthGrid_SOW_v0.2.pdf) and tailored TCO slide. (owner: Kimberly)
- 7/26: HealthGrid to return completed redwood_security_questionnaire.xlsx. (owner: Marcus Torres / Raj Patel)
- 7/29: Legal review begins (HealthGrid legal + Redwood legal). Please confirm signatory name for contracts — Claire, can you confirm who will sign SOW/PO?
- 8/18: Target vendor selection date.

We’ll also add the redacted SOC2 and pentest summary to the Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/HG-114-stakeholders.

Confirming Wed 7/25 10:00am PT for a 30-minute checkpoint — I’ll send a calendar invite once Claire confirms availability. If procurement needs a PO template or additional fields on the SOW, Luis, happy to take that offline.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: HealthGrid_SOW_v0.2.pdf (PDF)
